# Assay, AI governance and assurance

> Assay finds every AI system in a company, puts controls around it, and builds the
> documentation and evidence needed to answer a customer security review, an auditor,
> or an internal committee. Operated by Control and Function LLC, Denver, Colorado.
> Fully remote, United States. Not an audit firm.

## The three steps

1. Inventory. Find every AI system in use, including tools adopted without review.
   What it is, what data it touches, who depends on the output, what happens when
   it is wrong.
2. Control. Design controls people will follow: human review where it matters, access
   and data boundaries, change and model update handling, incident paths. Mapped to the
   NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001.
3. Evidence. Build evidence that accumulates from work people already do, so proof is a
   by-product rather than a scramble when a review lands.

## Engagement model

- First call: 30 minutes, no charge.
- Gap assessment: fixed price, scoped on a short call.
- Larger readiness engagements: quoted fixed before work starts.
- Operator led. The person who scopes the engagement does the work.

## Explicitly not

Not an audit firm and issues no certifications or opinions. Not a policy template vendor.
Not a software platform. Does not market regulatory deadlines that do not apply to the
client.
